description: This file is a shell script that contains tests and setup routines for the Git 'bundle' feature. It includes test descriptions, environment setup, function definitions for creating commits and tags, assertions using the test-lib.sh framework, and multiple test cases for creating, verifying, and manipulating Git bundles, including cloning, filtering, and concurrent reference handling.

methods.name: test_commit_setvar
methods.description: Creates a commit or tag with specified options, setting the variable to the object ID.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Formats git command output, replacing object IDs with placeholders for stable and human-readable output.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats and saves expected output for comparisons.
